warnings: Lower verandah roof over D-E', grids 1'-3'. Legend: thin = แป C-100x50x20x2.3 @1.50, solid = อะเส C-100x50x20x2.3 (row E, หลังอะเสระดับ +3.39), dashed = เหล็กรูปพรรณเสริมรับแป 2C-100x50x20x2.3, dash-dot = TRUSS T3.

The three dashed 2C members run along grids 1, 2, 3 from row D to the roof edge E' (1.00 beyond E); recorded as rafters (they carry the purlins down the slope), split at the row-E support where the อะเส and columns C1 sit.
TRUSS T3 is drawn on row D (small squares at D1, D2, D3 = the C1 columns) — the same T3 already recorded on S-03; not repeated here.
Four purlin lines are drawn between D and E' at about 1.15 m in plan, while the leader prints @1.50 m; kept the printed spacing, counted the drawn lines, lowered confidence.
